spec.size: 1024x1024 generate -> keyout -> fit into 460x460 card safe area
spec.view: strict frontal elevation, symmetrical (a few cards allow a 20-45 degree functional element)
spec.feature_rule: exactly ONE functional part, its orientation spelled out in words (horizontal/vertical/downward/angle)
spec.accent_rule: 1 main accent block + at most 2 small same-hue accents; single hue only
spec.palette: dark navy + 2 muted steel greys + 1 accent = 4 tones max
spec.background: solid flat #141726, optional single-layer grid under 6% contrast, no frame border
spec.negatives: no gradient, no shading, no glow, no halo, no lens flare, no painterly texture, no stipple, no hatching, no gear trains, no rivet rows, no layered armour, no circuitry, no ornament, no small greebles, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no characters, no scene, no environment, not isometric, not 3/4, not top-down, not a chess piece, not a lighthouse
spec.note: v4 frontal-elevation spec retained for reference; actual generation follows design/art/card-art-generation-standard-v1.md (3/4 view), see section 3.1

pack_color_rule: pack color is the DOMINANT tone of the whole card: about 60% or more of the visible body is painted in this hue using three flat tonal steps of the SAME hue (mid-tone main plate / lighter bevel highlight / darker shadow plate); only a few small structural parts stay neutral blue-grey steel; thick dark-navy outlines unchanged; pack color is SSOT for all 10 cards in the pack, no per-card override

postprocess_hint.completion: 81/81 cards (8 packs x10 + cinder extra slot Pyroclasm), 8/8 packs validated (2026-11-09); no pending card; engine-verified with Godot 4.7.2 (Steam) on 2026-11-09: import + 81-card load probe + export + UI screenshots

bright_pack.note: v1.3: high-luminance pack colors (cyan/gold) saturate the white point at 155; use with --dominant, whole pack only, never per card

mid_pack.note: v1.4: mid-luminance pack colors (L about 90-140, e.g. star-violet) are too dark under default white 155 and get darker under --bright-pack; lift the shadow floor instead of pushing highlights. Mutually exclusive with the other tone flags; use with --dominant, whole pack only, never per card. sunder needs the higher --lift-pack floor (v1.5); hex deep teal (v1.6) and true alert red (v1.7) are validated with --lift-pack. All 8 packs complete.

lift_pack.note: v1.5 + v1.6 + v1.7: packs with a very high share of dark shadow plates (sunder magenta-crimson #E8437F) or a low-luminance pack color (hex deep teal #1A6B7D L about 91, true alert red #FF2E4E L about 93) fail p50 under --mid-pack. Four-tier pilots: Hex 73/55/89/101, Oblivion 72/55/89/101 -> reuse 145/58 rather than adding a fifth tier. Whole packs passed: sunder p50 87-127, hex 101-138, true 88-108 (true p85 is naturally lower because red has only 0.2126 luminance weight). Mutually exclusive with --bright-pack / --mid-pack; use with --dominant, whole pack only, never per card. All 8 packs complete.
